dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you one of the inmates here too?

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Mm? No, I'm not! Though a Melusine who committed a crime would be punished the same as a human, it so happens that I am an innocent citizen.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: In fact, it's practically the opposite! I'm a member of the Marechaussee Phantom. But it's my day off, so I've come here to speak with a friend, that's all.
